"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will continue to support the Equal Rights Amendment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is committed to ensuring full equality for women.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is committed to vigorously enforcing the Americans with Disabilities Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports continuation of the White House initiative on Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will continue to work toward a census that counts every American.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports continued efforts, like the Employment Non-Discrimination Act, to end workplace discrimination against gay men and lesbians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports the full inclusion of gay and lesbian families in the life of the nation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party supports an equitable alignment of benefits for gay and lesbian families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party recognizes the importance of new battles against forms of discrimination and disadvantage that stand as barriers to communities and families, such as environmental injustices and predatory lending practices.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will fight for full funding and full staffing of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and other civil rights enforcement agencies so they can do their job of ensuring that America lives up to its creed of equal rights and equal opportunity for all.",
